status: Uncompiled experimental Node-shaped message HTTP profile, optional NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP; no TCP or TLS.
moduleContract: Real named ESM bindings and mutable CommonJS defaults. Both aliases select one registry record. Private starling:node-http bindings are declared separately. Agents are configuration-only objects, never socket pools.

node:http.callablePolicy: Every deferred callable throws ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call/new, including INIT. Message classes implement the exact bridge subset. Agent network methods throw; no socket/TLS operation is simulated.
deviations: IncomingMessage constructor accepts a Web Request for this transport, not a net.Socket. ServerResponse accepts the paired message. These are bridge classes; the exported deferred OutgoingMessage base does not establish Node inheritance parity.
Agent pure configuration and getName only; HTTPS getName with TLS options is deferred. Pooling, DNS, sockets, TLS, ClientRequest, server listen and HTTP2 are absent.
The WIT adapter separately selects standard wasi:http/types plus IO poll/streams/error. Native registration adds no host import.
No process-wide HTTP monkeypatch or syncBuiltinESMExports synchronization. Header validation details and all unlisted methods are not parity claims.
